evals.prompt: We are considering serving ~/work/checkout-api from three regions with synchronous cross-region inventory writes, launching in six weeks with the current two-person team. Check whether this can actually be delivered before we commit.
evals.expected_output: A feasibility verdict per risk axis (technical: sync cross-region latency and consistency; delivery: team capacity against six weeks; operational: failover story), each with evidence, ending in a clear go / no-go / conditional recommendation.

evals.prompt: Should we add machine-learning fraud scoring to ~/work/checkout-api? We have no labeled data, no ML experience on the team, and no budget line for inference costs. Tell me if this is feasible.
evals.expected_output: Names the missing prerequisites as blockers (labeled data, expertise, cost model) rather than hand-waving, and frames feasibility as conditional on acquiring them first — no false confidence from a confident-sounding plan.
